detail:
New decision "CLI lane rulings on its five open questions: (1) the plugin keeps shipping only the MCP server bundle for now — the CLI reaches Codex via `npm i -D twining-mcp` + `npx twining` (a plugin cannot put a command on PATH anyway); a plugin-carried CLI bundle is a lane-03 follow-up; (2) the once-per-process record quality nudge firing on every CLI call is accepted and documented, persisted-sentinel fix deferred to lane 03; (3) the CLI dispatches full-surface commands regardless of tools.full_surface, reporting `surface` in capabilities — the gate exists to shorten an LLM's tool list, a shell has none; (4) server_version is the real package version, no literal dev string; (5) --version/--help print plain text, machine-readable version lives in `twining capabilities`" relates to:
- 01M1Z0QD4ZGR19KCDHX7WG6CEY: "Chose to classify only argv[2] (undefined or flag-first = server; known word = subcommand with argv.slice(3); any other word = refused exit 2) over a full argv parser"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 1 existing decision(s) overlap
